_doc: Copy to ~/.config/security-feed-check/watchlist.json and add what you run (add the "linux" tag if you run Linux hosts yourself; Zero Wire already covers major kernel issues). 'tags' are pwn.watch tag ids (https://pwn.watch/tags.json); 'keywords' are whole-word, case-insensitive matches against each pwn.watch incident's product and title. Zero Wire items are never filtered.
_auto_update_doc: true: the agent may apply the narrow local updates described in SKILL.md. false: report only.
_projects_doc: Optional. local_lockfile_globs: lockfiles to read from disk, e.g. ["~/code/*/package-lock.json"]. deployed_projects: app name -> local repo checkout, e.g. {"my-app": "~/code/my-app"}; inventory reads each repo's origin default branch (Dockerfile + lockfiles). fly_postgres_apps: Fly Postgres app names to read images for.
